card.name: Ends of transporter names like BCRP
card.fires_on: The last letter of transporter abbreviations such as BCRP and P-gp in drug interaction text. It also fires on a few words that start transporter or gene names, like organic or Gene.

modes.label: End of BCRP or P-gp
modes.description: Final letter of the transporter abbreviation before the words substrate or inhibitor.

modes.label: Start of a longer name
modes.description: A word that opens a multiword transporter or gene name.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens, which are about opposites and 'contr' or 'to' pieces.
card.plain: It marks the end of a transporter name like BCRP or P-gp in drug interaction sections.
